description: The plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different model and benchmark combinations across varying numerical values. The x-axis lacks a specific title or units but displays numerical values on a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick marks and labels specifically placed at 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The blue solid line with circular markers, representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep," starts at approximately 0.20 at an x-value of 128, increases steadily to roughly 0.35 at 512, and ends with a very slight rise to about 0.36 at 1024. The orange solid line with square markers, representing "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," begins at roughly 0.15 at 128, rises to approximately 0.42 at 512, and remains completely steady at 0.42 through to 1024. The green solid line with upward-pointing triangular markers, representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," starts at approximately 0.07 at 128, climbs sharply to about 0.37 at 512, and levels off to end at roughly 0.38 at 1024. Finally, the red solid line with diamond markers, representing "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," begins at approximately 0.24 at 128, increases to about 0.42 at 512, and continues to rise to a peak of approximately 0.52 at 1024.
caption_used: The plot illustrates the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio' across different sample sizes for two models on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with sample sizes, presented on a linear scale with tick marks at values 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis represents the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio,' also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The blue line, representing 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,' starts at approximately 0.2 at 128, increases steadily to about 0.4 at 512, and remains constant through 1024. The orange line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,' begins at around 0.15, rises sharply to approximately 0.45 at 512, and stabilizes at that level through 1024. The green line, 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,' starts at approximately 0.08 and rises to nearly 0.4 by 512, remaining constant thereafter. The red line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,' begins at 0.25, reaches approximately 0.45 at 512, and slightly increases to 0.5 at 1024. There is a legend available at the bottom right of the plot to map different line styles to their labels.
